description: This Java class 'ContractController' is a Spring MVC controller managing contract-related web requests, including creating, accepting, and printing contracts.

classes.name: ContractController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling contract creation, acceptance, and printing operations.

methods.name: newContract
methods.description: Handles GET request to display form for creating a new contract for a specific client ID.

methods.name: registerUser
methods.description: Handles POST request to create and save a new contract, or send it for approval based on validation and user permissions.

methods.name: acceptContract
methods.description: Handles GET request to accept a contract if the current user is authorized.

methods.name: printContract
methods.description: Handles GET request to print a contract if it has been accepted.
